notes.title: Jump into the Brand New Hello Neighbor 2 Demo - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there![/h2]

It feels like it was only last week the last time we talked...oh wait, it was! We must have lost track of time because we were too excited preparing for the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321680/Hello_Neighbor_2/][b]BRAND NEW DEMO[/b][/url] that just went live! This time, we visit a familiar and rather in(famous) locale, but something feels a bit [i]strange[/i]. Well, more strange than usual, that is.

Come in, come in. Be sure to step over the screaming rubber chickens there, and don't mind the seven-foot-tall stuffed rabbit in the corner, it doesn't bite. And no, it didn't just move. Grab your press ID and tighten those high-top laces, it's time to return to the house where it all began in this self-contained demo experience!

[previewyoutube=G7jExB-3ULE;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Check out the Demo Teaser! [/b]

Unraveling an entire town's twisted web of mysteries is going to be a long and tough job for all you junior investigative journalists. So to keep those skills sharp, why don't we start with a single house? Reclusive inventor Theodore Peterson has something to do with the recent string of missing children reports in the town of Raven Brooks, you just know it. It's up to you to find out exactly what he's hiding in this one-shot, spoiler-free adventure. Just tread carefully... and watch your back!

Make sure that you have [url=https://tblink.co/HN2Steam][b]Hello Neighbor 2 on your wishlist[/b][/url] to be in the know about any news & updates leading up to our full game launch. [/b] And if you want to be one of the first to set foot in the open world of Raven Brooks on December 6th, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321680/Hello_Neighbor_2/][b]you can pre-purchase the Hello Neighbor 2 Standard or Deluxe Editions[/b][/url]. With the Deluxe Edition containing 3 brand new DLC on launch, and 5 days of Early Access to the game prior to its full release!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/0c2a4292ca9894157a852c0a19728b1a15e13b15.jpg[/img]
If you liked the Demo, please feel free to [url=http://discord.gg/neighborgames][b]join our Discord server[/b][/url]. We have dedicated channels just for feedback and we’d love to hear what you think, see you in Raven Brooks!

Cheers,
tinyFox, tinyBuild & Eerie Guest Studios

notes.title: Hello Neighbor 2 Beta + Pre-orders are NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/18e034b7cd8f364dc834b45e10ed49acd5f02a04.png[/img]
[h2]Attention Neighbors! This is not a drill!![/h2]

No it’s not a belated April fools prank, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321680/Hello_Neighbor_2/]Hello Neighbor 2 pre-orders are NOW LIVE![/url][/b]
We’re super excited and have so much to go over so read on to hear more about our long-awaited Beta, brand new launch-day devlog, sweet new merch, and the Hello Neighbor 2…[i][b]Deluxe Edition?!?[/b][/i] 👀

[h3][url=https://youtu.be/Ys3zFmvoyQM][b]Or check out the devlog here for a bird’s..err, cats-eye view![/b][/url][/h3]

[h3]Beta Business[/h3]

We know you’ve been dying to book your ticket back to Raven Brooks, and starting today you can officially pre-order the long-awaited sequel to the original stealth horror hit! But in even better news, all pre-order players will be granted [b]instant[/b] access to our pre-order exclusive Beta! 

So what can you look forward to in the Beta and how do you get your mitts on it? Let’s get into it. You may have noticed there are two editions currently available for pre-order. The Hello Neighbor 2 Standard Edition pre-order will contain the full game on launch + instant Beta access once your pre-order is completed. Now for the the Deluxe Edition, both versions will grant you Beta access but of course, the Deluxe Edition comes with a few pretty sweet extras. Namely, 3 brand new DLC available on launch, and 5 days of Early Access to the game prior to its full release on December 6th, 2022!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/05a2b271b81c5afd99eabf829b851441070f8954.png[/img]

The Beta itself is what we like to call the Encapsulated Hello Neighbor 2 Beta Experience. While Hello Neighbor 2 is still in development, we're excited to bring you a taste of what visiting Raven Brooks will look and feel like with many of its new locations, residents, and visuals. Certain gameplay elements such as breakable windows and boxes will be waiting for you in the full release. And did we mention the Beta is spoiler-free? We’re saving all of the biggest secrets for launch day so feel free to dive right in! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/c4e0b550009307a2bce0fdb770c92933725bc23a.png[/img]

[h2]Merch Madness[/h2]

We’ve been working on this for a while and it’s finally time to let the cat out of the bag…literally. [url=https://shop.tinybuild.com/products/imbir-cat-plush][b]Bring home a piece of Hello Neighbor 2 with our brand new Imbir plush![/b][/url] Lovingly designed by HN2's Lead Artist Elena, you can be sure every inch of this plush is extra huggable right down to the embroidered toe beans, adopt yours today!

We also just dropped a whole batch of limited edition [url=https://shop.tinybuild.com/products/8-pin-set][b]Hello Neighbor 2 enamel pins[/b][/url]! You can snag your favorite character,  or if you’re like me and just can’t choose a favorite, grab the whole set! Our new merch just went live on the tinyBuild Shop so go check it out now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/259b9aa0179031c42f651dd73ffa4cf64879da07.png[/img]

But wait! we have one last Pre-order/Beta launch surprise for you all today. Get alternately relaxed and unnerved with [url=https://youtu.be/oYS6-irG2zs][b]Lofi Neighborhood Radio![/b][/url]  
Featuring hours of remixes to your favorite old and new HN tracks!  [url=https://youtu.be/oYS6-irG2zs][b]Watch the live stream![/b][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/5319fde0753feb0e671e07bbffd5aaec68834c32.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy the Beta, and if you haven’t already please feel free to join our Discord server. We have dedicated channels just for feedback and we’d love to hear what you think! And before we sign off, the team and I also wanted to say a big thank you to our longtime Steam community for their support over the years! We can’t wait to see you in Raven Brooks.
We’ll see you on the case! 

Cheers,
tinyFox, tinyBuild & Eerie Guest Studios

notes.title: The Hello Neighbor Showcase!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there![/h2]

We’ve just wrapped up [b]The Hello Neighbor Showcase,[/b] our online direct event outlining the many new and exciting updates to come throughout the Hello Neighbor Franchise. In case you missed the event let’s go over what you can look forward to in the coming months!

[previewyoutube=QIkqToWd6ZE;full][previewyoutube=c8iml-S-DsA;full][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Secret Neighbor is sneaking onto a platform near you![/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/axUpY6Q.gif[/img]

It’s been hard to keep this secret locked up but it’s escaped the basement and finally, we can share it. 

We’re excited to announce that [b]Secret Neighbor will be coming to PlayStation, Nintendo Switch, and iOS![/b] Pre orders for Secret Neighbor on PlayStation will open on March 30th. The full game release for PlayStation and iOS will be April 29th, and release plans for Secret Neighbor on Switch will be announced later this Summer. Another important update, our PlayStation and iOS versions will be cross-play compatible!

In addition to this, we are working hard to provide all platforms a parity of content and synchronized updates in the future and will keep you updated on our progression towards this goal. Our 2021 Secret Neighbor Development Roadmap will also be on its way to you in the coming weeks, so keep a sharp eye out for even more updates very soon!

[h2]Hello Neighbor 2 - The AI takeover[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4muhXH5.gif[/img]

Hello Neighbor 2 is nearing its crucial development stage and we are working hard on Alpha 2. There have been some big updates to the AI. Mr. Peterson is now even more capable of learning from previous player behavior in order to plan new ways to thwart you from learning his dark secrets. 

But not just Mr. Peterson, every character you encounter in Hello Neighbor 2 will share the same AI core...though their motivations and stories may differ. 

[h2]Hello Engineer - Full steam ahead[/h2]

Hello Engineer Beta Testing is currently in progress and we will be sharing more exciting news on its development soon. In the meantime, check out some fun gifs!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/sWhIcP1.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/AyeyTuO.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/s04gvuM.gif[/img]

[h2]The Guest is back and he’s...huggable?[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/R9oyC4q.gif[/img]

In partnership with our friends at Snap Creative, we are very excited to bring you The Guest Musical Plush! 

He is poseable, with wired limbs and a swivel head. And he has not one but two music boxes! Press his belly to play music, or press his bag for a surprise! 

He is made from soft cotton fabrics and approximately 10.5” tall. Pre-orders are now open and the estimated delivery of this cuddly menace is September 2021. 

[b]Pre-Order your own Guest now![/b]
https://shophelloneighbor.com/

[h2]Hello Neighbor is getting some TLC[/h2]

And last but not least, over the past few months we’ve been working behind the scenes to update and improve Hello Neighbor mobile version performance and gameplay and will continue to make some additional updates moving forward.

Thank you for checking our The Hello Neighbor Showcase!

Catch you later!
tinyFox, tinyBuild & the HoloGryph team

notes.title: Alpha 1.5 - Patch 2 - A Fistful Of Fixes
notes.content:

Today we're coming at you with another batch of fixes for Alpha 1.5. Please let us know if we missed anything!

[b]Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1.5 v1.1.1.5 - Full list of changes[/b]

[i][list]
[*] Added statistics on the time spent to complete the alpha
[*] Improved optimization
[*] Added some animations for the Guest
[*] Graphics settings have been expanded (material quality setting)
[*] The volume of the combination lock is increased
[*] Fixed bugs related to AI getting stuck in the house
[*] Fixed the Guest’s reaction to the kettle
[*] Fixed a bug where a candy in hand was considered to be placed inside the basket
[*] Fixed a bug where a player would lose control after the Guest had caught them in a hiding spot
[/list][/i]

Have fun!

-Imbir🐾, Eerie Guest & tinyBuild

notes.title: Alpha 1.5 - Patch 1 - A Ton of Fixes
notes.content:
Hello ghosts and ghouls!

Thank you all for playing Alpha 1.5 in these last couple of days! We really appreciate your feedback, keep it coming! Not only it helps us to catch all the bugs much quicker, but also to determine where to nudge the game gameplay-wise. 

You may have noticed an in-game survey that pops up after you've played for a bit - this is one of the new ways of listening to your thoughts on the game. Let us know what you think about the new Guest behavior and the new puzzles so that we could make the next Alphas even more fun!

And now, to the update itself. The team has been working tirelessly to eliminate the peskiest of bugs and improve the overall quality of life for Alpha 1.5, and the first patch is now out! There's a lot of fixes. Like, a lot. Take a look for yourself:

[b]Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1.5 v1.1.1.4 - Full list of changes[/b]

[i][list]
[*] Backyard house roof got updated geometry for easier jumps
[*] Updated decorations inside the house and in the open world
[*] Stationary phone has been moved to the bedroom
[*] Crowbar puzzle is now more intuitive
[*] Optimized lighting, other optimizations
[*] The Guest can now disassemble the generator if it's in their way
[*] Polished the final cutscene (added sound)
[*] Optimized sound levels (balancing)
[*] The Guest can no longer spot a player through the main door
[*] Improved one of the puzzles for obtaining a candy with the generator
[*] Lost candies are now more visible in the basket
[*] The cable now rolls up correctly while attached to the generator
[*] Decreased the probability of the camera shifting after being caught by the Guest
[*] The Guest now knocks down an installed CCTV camera instead of being blocked by it
[*] You can't block doors with the CCTV camera anymore
[*] Bottles' fullness is now correctly displayed in the inventory
[*] Fixed player's detection in hiding spots
[*] Fixed a bug where the Guest would freeze after a key has been taken out of the furnace
[*] The Guest no longer T-poses :(
[*] Fixed the bug related to the Guest opening the coded door
[*] Improved the Guest's behavior on neutral grounds
[*] The Guest no longer attacks a player while they're in the van
[*] Fixed incorrect Guest indication on the CCTV display
[*] Fixed incorrect display of candies when thrown into the basket 
[/list][/i]

Let us know in the comments what are the important issues that remain unfixed!

-Imbir🐾, Eerie Guest & tinyBuild

notes.title: Alpha 1.5 Is Out!
notes.content:
Hello ghosts and ghouls!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/K3uLiyh.gif[/img]

Just in time for Halloween, Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1.5 is HERE!
As previously mentioned this is not a drastic update but we do still have some goodies to hand out. And you don’t even have to dress up or knock on strangers' doors to get them!
[i](you just have to break into their house)[/i].

[previewyoutube=gnjvh9eQaAU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New treats! (and tricks)[/h2]

So what's new in Alpha 1.5 :

[i][list]
[*] Main house rework - you’ll find more ways to get around, and more interesting interactions and opportunities to maneuver through the House.
[*] AI rework - the Guest's behavior is now more complex, and it boasts new navigation, sight and hearing systems!
[*] Improved open world - This is the first iteration of the improved open world with more meaningful exploration. So put on your comfiest shoes and get out there! 
[*] More story for you to discover! The update will shed some light on Raven Brook’s secrets… but we can’t promise you’ll be left with more answers than questions.
[*] Improved game mechanics - the rope and the conveyor belt are now implemented as more integral parts of the gameplay
[*] Reworked level design - now it's easier for the new players to get into the game and understand the goal. This rework is aimed at making the game more accessible to new players while still giving veteran players more than enough to sink their teeth into.
[*] Sadly the 12 foot skeleton was sold out at home depot, but we have prepared a special Halloween puzzle just for you, as well as other non-giant skeleton Halloween decor. 
[*] And lastly, we’ve got another treat for you! Every player who wishlists Hello Neighbor 2 will receive a unique tool which will help you explore Raven Brooks - the Grappling Hook! Let us know in the comments or on our Discord if it was fun to use, and how much did it alter your playstyle.
[/list][/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G3xkfGa.gif[/img]

Happy Halloween and see you in Raven Brooks! !  /ᐠ𝅒 ‸ 𝅒ᐟ\ﾉฅ

-Imbir🐾, Eerie Guest & tinyBuild

notes.title: Alpha 1.5 - Work In Progress
notes.content:
[h2]Hey everyone![/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LzGkya7.gif[/img]

Hello Neighbor 2 Alpha 1.5 is not that far away. Can you guess when is it coming by looking at these gifs? :)

Meanwhile, we wanted to share with you what we've been working on for this update. As you could tell from the Alpha name, the game will not be drastically different from the Alpha 1. Instead, we've focused our attention inwards: for the past couple of months, we've been busy improving the gameplay.

[h2]The Survey[/h2]

As a part of this inward focus, we'd like to hear more from you, our players. The purpose of the last survey was to get to know you better. With this one, we're looking to get your feedback on the gameplay of HN2 Alpha 1, which will help us make adjustments to the future Alphas.

[url=https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/HN2A1gameplay]Here's the link[/url]. Huge thanks for participating!!


Without showing all the cards, here's a brief outline of what we've been working on:

[h2]The Changes[/h2]

[i][list]
[*] Reworked the main house: added more interactions and interesting opportunities for a player to traverse the house
[*] Reworked the AI - the Guest's behavior is now more complex, with a more coherent cycle (schedule) 
[*] Improved open world - we've heard you loud and clear - it's nice to have an open world, but there's got to be a point in exploring it. This is the first iteration of the improved open world, with some cheeky puzzles, and more are to come in the future versions of the game.
[*] More lore! New intro and ending will expand the lore of Hello Neighbor universe. We can't promise that you'd get more answers than questions, though.
[*] Improved mechanics - the rope and the conveyor belt are now implemented as more integral parts of the gameplay
[*] Reworked level design - now it's easier for the new players to get into the game and understand the goal. This rework is aimed at making the game more accessible to new players while remaining mysterious and challenging
[*] Halloween is coming! We're preparing a special Halloween puzzle and other tricks (and treats)
[/list][/i]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/ARNNOz9.gif[/img]

Catch you later!

- 
Eerie Guest & tinyBuild
